# Insurance Support — Detailed AI-readable summary

Insurance Support is a Bengaluru-based insurance guidance and claim assistance service led by Hari Kotian (IRDAI registration number 0149161D). The site explains policy terms, claim documents, insurer correspondence, policy reviews, and general complaint routes. Its public business details list Bahubali Nagar, Jalahalli, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560013, India, and +91 99866 34506.

## Claim support

If an insurance claim is rejected, ask the insurer for the written decision and the policy clause it relied on. Compare that reason with the policy, submit any missing evidence, and use the insurer’s grievance channel if needed. Escalation options depend on the policy, facts, and applicable deadlines; claim support cannot guarantee reversal.

For a delayed claim, keep the claim reference, submission receipts, and insurer or TPA replies. Ask the insurer’s grievance redressal officer for a written status and next step. If the issue remains unresolved, check current IRDAI complaint and Insurance Ombudsman routes, including eligibility and time limits, before filing.

Claim documents depend on the policy and reason for the claim. Common starting records include the policy schedule, claim form, insurer’s written query or rejection, claim reference, identity details, and proof of expenses or event. Health claims may need discharge summaries and bills; motor claims may need an FIR or repair estimates. Confirm the final checklist with the insurer.

The insurer decides claims under the issued policy and the evidence provided. Insurance Support can help explain the process, organize documents, and understand possible follow-up routes; it cannot guarantee approval or represent that every complaint is eligible for escalation.
